selection: Same frozen six development cases, no reselection or rule tuning
cache_policy: Reuse complete one-minute probes and cached Aug24 BTCT prefix. Fetch only uncovered intervals. Capped pages resume inclusively at the last returned timestamp; boundary overlap is intentional to avoid skipping same-time events. No advancing beyond a timestamp if the provider stalls. Keep all errors and checkpoint remaining intervals. Do not fetch an already saved identical query.
scheduler: All initial intervals in sample order first, then capped continuations FIFO until exhausted or 20 calls used. No provider retries during this run.
completeness: Uncapped successful retrieval is API interval coverage, not quote freshness, receipt completeness or executable fill evidence. Same-time duplicates and unknown quote size units are not silently repaired.

price_diagnostic.anchor: First positive uncrossed quote at/after frozen minute entry; ask anchor. Thresholds +10%/-3% relative to that observed ask; inspect subsequent bids through the original 60-minute deadline. No bar-label replacement or fill claim.
price_diagnostic.simultaneous_timestamp: If an event timestamp contains both target and stop, order is unknown. An API coverage gap before a crossing makes first-touch unknown.
price_diagnostic.latency: Historical event timestamps only; actual receipt/processing latency unknown
price_diagnostic.no_quote_timeout: Require a valid quote within 3 seconds at/after deadline for timeout indication; otherwise unknown. No stale carry-forward.

execution_gates: causal lagged volume at each potential fill
historical receipt or declared latency scenarios
calibrated fees/impact and full retrieval coverage
decision: No profit or calibrated probability claims; no live-rule changes; preserve negatives and unknowns. Quote indications are measurement only.
